name: Martin Franks MIMI
quote:
To whom it may concern:

I met Sifiso around twenty years ago, whilst working in my region of the UK, Africa, the Middle East, and Turkey. Sifiso is a very amiable and capable support person, with many years' experience working with the Kerridge/ADP/CDK Autoline DMS products in the region. He has travelled extensively across the region, including for advanced training in the UK. He is an asset when building client relationships as a trusted partner; one example was Subaru South Africa, who were so pleased with his support that they surprised him with the loan of an incredible Subaru for a weekend. Sifiso also went on to manage the in-house Kerridge support helpdesk at Daimler ZA, leading that team for several years.

The crucial question is whether I would employ him; the answer would be yes. He has customer relations experience and an understanding of the automotive retail business and its processes.

For your information, I am an automotive professional with over 50 years' experience, currently semi-retired and working as a business consultant in business data.

Kind regards,

Martin Franks MIMI
